evals.name: screen-recording-with-webcam-bubble
evals.prompt: Make a reel from talk_screen.mp4, 02:10 to 03:17. It's a screen recording with my webcam bubble in the bottom-right corner, and the recorder zooms the bubble in and out. CTA keyword GUIDE.
expected_behavior: Runs find_cuts.py and verify_cut_edges.sh; every speech cut lands in a verified silence and the reel opens on a sentence start
Tracks the animated bubble with track_bubble.py instead of a fixed crop
Uses setup_project.sh and the reference composition; scenes follow the mode table (split, studio incl. one 5-6 s window, full face, one dark beat <=2 s, framed web card, full-screen CTA card)
Captions are 1-3 words per chip, in the seam row during split scenes
check_glyphs prints NONE, hyperframes check has 0 errors, loudness is -14 +/-0.7 LUFS, no silent head or tail
Delivers a full-quality mp4 and a share copy under 30 MB plus the cut list and judge score

evals.name: full-frame-talking-head-transcript-excerpt
evals.prompt: Here's the part I want as a Short, from my podcast.mp4 (just me on camera the whole time): "the reason most teams fail at onboarding is that they explain the tool before the problem..." up to "...and that's the whole trick." English, CTA word ONBOARD.
expected_behavior: Locates the excerpt in a word-level transcript (transcribes with transcribe.sh if none exists) and maps it to exact times
Keeps LTR direction for chips and motion, and extends nothing Hebrew-specific
Uses the full-frame face for split, full-face shots; no bubble tracking
Keeps any filler that has no pause on both sides and reports it
Produces the approved look, not a banner/PIP/subtitle-bar template

evals.name: different-reference-reel
evals.prompt: Same process as last time but copy the style of this reel instead: https://www.instagram.com/reel/EXAMPLE/ — clip is lecture.mp4 14:02-14:40.
expected_behavior: Downloads the new reference with yt-dlp for analysis only and makes 1 fps and 5 fps sheets plus cut detection
Writes the measured grammar into a copy of design-system.md and adapts criterion 1 of the judge prompt before composing
Runs the judge loop against the new reference, stopping at >=90 % or explaining the plateau
